relations.rationale: Catching up before opening books sets up a natural transition to suggesting a recap, but doesn't directly imply it.
Spending time catching up is a social detail unrelated to whether they agree to meet again next week.
Laughing about a mix-up is unrelated to a future decision to meet again.
Milo being taller than Nell says nothing about Isla's height relative to Nell.
Hana's suggestion directly precedes and likely causes the group's agreement/nodding.
Suggesting a recap of previous chapters is unrelated to Isla's later differing interpretation during discussion.
Suggesting a recap supports the idea of an engaged, ongoing discussion evening.
Everyone nodding in agreement has no bearing on relative heights.
Nodding in agreement is unrelated to Nell's separate offer to pour tea.
Isla's height compared to Nell has no bearing on her offering a differing interpretation of the book.
Finn bringing snacks is an unrelated social detail to Nell offering tea.
Nell pouring tea is unrelated to Milo sharing thoughts on the protagonist.
Nell offering tea is unrelated to Isla's differing interpretation.
Milo sharing his interpretation sets up a natural opportunity for Isla to counter with a different one.
Milo's sharing thoughts contributes to and supports the described evening of lively debate.
An enjoyable evening of debate and engagement supports the group's decision to continue meeting.
